Most of the points have been raised and have been answered by the minister and his officials. I think everyone agrees that the principle of the bill is good, that everything that can possibly be done to make a vehicle safer should be done. I appreciate the minister's desire to have the bill passed in time to have some of these provisions effective in the current year. I do not want to delay passage of the bill. However, there are one or two questions I would like the minister to answer in his final March 11.

BasePK: 2651345
Chunk index: 1

Speech chunk:
1970 Motor Vehicle Safety remarks. No bill is perfect in its draft stage. There were a couple of serious flaws in the bill as originally drafted. After spending two or three days studying the bill, I felt I was barking up the wrong tree and there was something wrong with me, but eventually the minister and his officials recognized and corrected these defects.
